about: The playthrough's Slowpoke Well, from Azalea's Pokemon Center: a swap puts the Geodude second, behind the Misdreavus -- its Confusion for Proton's Ekans, Koffing and Gulpin, the Geodude's Rock moves for his Murkrow and Houndour -- then down the well to Executive Proton and his five; a loss sends the player to the nurse, and again: walks back and fights him again, each attempt a new battle (the battle seed one higher), four times more at most. After him Kurt's scene and the warp to his house, where his frame script (VAR_UNK_4080 2) gives the Fast Ball (FLAG_UNK_07C) and his granddaughter's phone number (VAR_UNK_4080 4); the nurse, and the game's save. The party is trained here, and says so: the team the bot caught comes with its experience on its lead -- the Misdreavus 18, the Cyndaquil 15, the Geodude 14, the Hoothoot 13 -- and Proton beat it five times running in each of three orders (this one, the party as it came and the Geodude first), fifteen battles, a new one each time; in this order his Gulpin -- Yawn, Encore and Amnesia, its Black Sludge -- was the last standing all five times. So savedit --train raises the four to the cap, 19, where a player's grinding would: the Cyndaquil evolved by level to Quilava, each with the moves the game gives it there, the egg left an egg. Then the first battle was lost and the second won where the leg was written, the Hoothoot, last standing, finishing the Gulpin; 51,915 frames. Training the four to 19 in play (Route 33's and Union Cave's Pokemon, at 10 to 14, pay them little) is what remains. The field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.

lines: You are challenged by Executive Proton!
